utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Please call the case, Mr. Registrar.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. This is case number IT-05-88-A, the Prosecutor versus Vujadin Popovic et al. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: And the appearances. The Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. WOOD
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. Kyle Wood and Francois Boudreault for the Prosecution, along with our case manager, Colin Nawrot.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. And for the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. Zoran Zivanovic on behalf of Mr. Vujadin Popovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. OSTOJIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. John Ostojic on behalf of Mr. Ljubisa Beara.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MS. NIKOLIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honour. Jelena Nikolic on behalf of Mr. Dragan Nikolic, with our assistant Ms. Marlene Yahya.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MS. FAVEAU
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. Natacha Faveau-Ivanovic with Nenad Petrusic for Radivoje Miletic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KRGOVIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. Dragan Krgovic on behalf of General Milan Gvero.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. HAYNES
utterances.text: And lastly, Your Honour, Peter Haynes on behalf of Vinko Pandurevic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. Let me begin by giving a summary of the status of the briefing process and the motions pending before the Chamber. Two motions are filed by Mr. Popovic pursuant to Rule 115. These are the third and fourth motions under Rule 115 filed on the 15th of August, 2011, and the 19th of September, 2011. All responses and replies to these two motions have been received by the Appeals Chamber and both motions remain under consideration by the Chamber. Two motions were filed by Miletic pursuant to Rule 115, the first and second motions pursuant to Rule 115 filed on the 30th of March, 2012, and the 7th of May, 2012. All responses and replies to these two motions as well as their English translations have been received by the Appeals Chamber and the Chamber will give a ruling shortly. Private session. We move into private session.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We're back in open session, Your Honour. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: And I now ask the appellants whether they wish to raise any concerns regarding their health or the conditions of their detention. Mr. Popovic, do you have any matters to raise? THE APPELLANT POPOVIC: [Interpretation] No, Your Honour, there is nothing we need to inform you of. If we have any problems, we deal with them over there. There are no problems.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Beara. THE APPELLANT BEARA: [Interpretation] Everything is quite normal and customary. I have no objections to make.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Mr. Nikolic. THE APPELLANT NIKOLIC: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I'm in good health and there are no problems in the Detention Unit. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Miletic. THE APPELLANT MILETIC: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I have no requests or any problems of any kind.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: And Mr. Pandurevic. THE APPELLANT PANDUREVIC: [Interpretation] Everything is fine, Your Honour. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. And may I ask whether any members of the Prosecution or any of the Defence counsel have any matters to raise?

utterances.speaker: MR. WOOD
utterances.text: Nothing from the Prosecution. Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Anything from the Defence? Okay. There being no other matters to be raised, the hearing is adjourned.
